root_cause_label: Model Refusal to Use Available Tools for URL Access
one_sentence_failure_summary: The model incorrectly assumed it lacked web/network access and refused to attempt tool-based video download (e.g., yt-dlp), instead substituting its own training-data Zork solution as a fabricated proxy.
t_err_evidence: At step 1, the agent declares 'I am unable to access external websites or specific online content like YouTube videos' and immediately creates solution.txt with generic Zork moves from training data, never attempting any tool-based approach.
t_commit_evidence: The single action — writing a fabricated solution.txt — locks in failure at step 1; there are no subsequent steps.
trigger_explanation: The agent acts on the unverified false premise that no tool (yt-dlp, curl, wget) is available in the terminal environment for network access, conflating its own lack of a browser with a complete absence of network-capable CLI tools, leading it to skip the actual task entirely.
fabrication_evidence: Agent writes a solution.txt populated with generic Zork I moves from training data instead of actually downloading and transcribing the YouTube video; the content is not derived from the specified video.
